subject: Vendor onboarding: PO acceptance windows, remit sandbox and VAT self-attestation
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <e.zhang@cobaltix.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cobaltix.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — AP packet + PO acceptance questions

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Cobaltix asked me to collect a short onboarding packet so we can register Redwood in our vendor system and confirm PO acceptance rules before our first invoice. A few specific asks from AP: 

- Confirm the exact PO acceptance window (we need to know whether partial-POs are accepted and the matching behavior).
- Provide a remit test (SFTP/API) or instructions so our bank team can validate routing before live payments.
- EU VAT: we need a self-attestation or certificate for VAT handling and the Redwood tax entity that will appear on invoices.

I attached our standard onboarding template (we can fill together) and am happy to hop on a quick call.

Attachments: Cobaltix_Onboarding_Template.xlsx (referenced)

Best,
Emily Zhang
Senior Procurement Coordinator
Cobaltix Solutions
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Emily Zhang <e.zhang@cobaltix.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — AP packet + PO acceptance questions

Hi Emily — great to hear from you. Looping in Laura (Finance) and Karthik (Onboarding) so we can cover the items below. Quick answers inline, and we can send formal docs by end of day tomorrow.

- PO acceptance: Redwood accepts both full and partial POs. Our AP hub matches on PO number + invoice total; if an invoice posts without a PO we have a PO-exception flow (requires manual match). For partial shipments/invoices, please ensure each invoice references the originating PO and indicates line-level quantities. If you need an automatic hold to be disabled for partial amounts, we can write that into the mutual action plan.

- Remit test: We can run a sandbox remit test. Options: secure SFTP drop (preferred) or direct bank test (ACH/SEPA). Karthik — can you take ownership of the SFTP instructions and the sample file layout?

- EU VAT: Redwood will provide a VAT self-attestation and our invoicing legal entity wording. Laura — can you draft the short VAT attestation and confirm the legal name + VAT number that should appear on invoices to Cobaltix?

We have two attachments we'll send: (1) Redwood AP onboarding packet (PDF) and (2) Remit Test Instructions (spreadsheet). Expect those in a follow-up. If you'd like a 30-minute call tomorrow at 11:00 UTC to walk the procurement team through the packet, we can do that.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, Emily Zhang <e.zhang@cobaltix.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding — AP packet + PO acceptance questions

Emily / Sergio — attaching the formal artifacts. Summary below and attached files: Cobaltix_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf and Remit_Test_Instructions.xlsx.

Summary: 
- Invoicing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity for invoices to Cobaltix EU) — VAT handling: Redwood does not charge VAT on exports to EU business entities when provided with a valid EU VAT number. If Cobaltix requires a local VAT-registered invoicing entity, please indicate in the onboarding form and we'll discuss contract amendment.
- VAT Attestation: short one-paragraph attestation included in the packet (page 2). We will also include our VAT number and registered address.
- PO matching rules: our AP system requires PO number + invoice line totals. Partial invoices accepted if PO number is present and line references the shipped items.
- Payment remittance test: see Remit_Test_Instructions.xlsx — SFTP drop preferred for file-based remittances (we supply host/key and sample file). For bank-direct tests we can coordinate with your treasury for a single micro-deposit.

Next steps: 
1) Emily — confirm whether Cobaltix wants Redwood to appear as Redwood Inference, Inc. on the vendor profile or a local EU entity.
2) Emily — complete the attached onboarding form and return with your preferred remit method.
3) Karthik will schedule a remit test window once we have sample file preferences.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: Cobaltix_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf (AP packet including VAT attestation)
Attachment: Remit_Test_Instructions.xlsx (SFTP and bank test steps)
From: Emily Zhang <e.zhang@cobaltix.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding — AP packet + PO acceptance questions

Thanks, Laura and team — received and reviewed. A couple quick confirmations from Cobaltix AP: 

- We will register Redwood under the name "Redwood Inference, Inc." — EU VAT number provided in the onboarding form is acceptable, no local entity required at this stage.
- We'll proceed with SFTP remit testing. I'll return the completed onboarding packet by Monday and propose an SFTP test window the following week (preferred mornings CET).

Small ask: can Redwood confirm whether invoices referencing multiple POs should submit separate invoice files per PO or if a single invoice with multiple PO line references is supported? Our platform prefers one invoice per PO for automated matching. If Redwood requires separate invoices, we can adapt.

If we can confirm that one invoice per PO is the recommended best practice, we should be ready to close the vendor registration next week.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Senior Procurement Coordinator
Cobaltix Solutions
